title: Comparison phase outcome
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input, let $y$ be a bit string, and let $R$ be a vector of 21 natural-number registers whose values are all at most $(8W(N)+8)(|y|+1)$. Suppose register $T$ has value $0$. If the value of register $\mathrm{Pos}$ is at most that of register $N_1$, the constructed register machine reaches its designated next phase—$E2$ in step mode and the clearing phase otherwise—without changing the register valuation, while satisfying the bound and the machine's precondition throughout. If $\mathrm{Pos}>N_1$, it instead halts with answer $0$, also satisfying those conditions throughout its run.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input
all 21 registers of R are bounded by (8W(N)+8)(|y|+1)
mode is one of valid, init, accept, or step
